data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old German elements 'ermen' meaning 'ruler, lord' and 'ric' meaning 'power, rule'. The name Emrich has been borne by numerous individuals throughout history, particularly in Germany. It conveys a sense of strength and leadership. The name Emrich carries the meaning “Powerful ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Emrich usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
